# xcsh provider documentation

Load fundamentals first, then the property reference or immediate children. Fetch complete relevant leaves. The machine index supplies exact paths, relationships and digests.

- [Machine index](https://f5-sales-demo.github.io/terraform-provider-xcsh/terraform-llms-index.json)

- [resources/address_allocator](https://f5-sales-demo.github.io/terraform-provider-xcsh/resources/address_allocator/): Manages Address Allocator will create an address allocator object in 'system' namespace of the user in F5 Distributed Cloud.
- [resources/advertise_policy](https://f5-sales-demo.github.io/terraform-provider-xcsh/resources/advertise_policy/): Manages an Advertise Policy resource in F5 Distributed Cloud for advertise_policy object controls how and where a service represented by a given virtual_host object is advertised to consumers. configuration.
- [resources/alert_gen_policy](https://f5-sales-demo.github.io/terraform-provider-xcsh/resources/alert_gen_policy/): Manages Alert Generation Policy in F5 Distributed Cloud.
- [resources/alert_policy](https://f5-sales-demo.github.io/terraform-provider-xcsh/resources/alert_policy/): Manages new Alert Policy Object in F5 Distributed Cloud.
- [resources/alert_receiver](https://f5-sales-demo.github.io/terraform-provider-xcsh/resources/alert_receiver/): Manages new Alert Receiver object in F5 Distributed Cloud.
- [resources/alert_template](https://f5-sales-demo.github.io/terraform-provider-xcsh/resources/alert_template/): Manages Domain to protect in F5 Distributed Cloud.
- [resources/allowed_domain](https://f5-sales-demo.github.io/terraform-provider-xcsh/resources/allowed_domain/): Manages allowed domain in F5 Distributed Cloud.
- [resources/api_crawler](https://f5-sales-demo.github.io/terraform-provider-xcsh/resources/api_crawler/): Manages an API Crawler resource in F5 Distributed Cloud.
- [resources/api_definition](https://f5-sales-demo.github.io/terraform-provider-xcsh/resources/api_definition/): Manages API Definition in F5 Distributed Cloud.
- [resources/api_discovery](https://f5-sales-demo.github.io/terraform-provider-xcsh/resources/api_discovery/): Manages API discovery creates a new object in the storage backend for metadata.namespace in F5 Distributed Cloud.
- [resources/api_testing](https://f5-sales-demo.github.io/terraform-provider-xcsh/resources/api_testing/): Manages an API Testing resource in F5 Distributed Cloud.
- [resources/app_api_group](https://f5-sales-demo.github.io/terraform-provider-xcsh/resources/app_api_group/): Manages app_api_group creates a new object in the storage backend for metadata.namespace in F5 Distributed Cloud.
- [resources/app_firewall](https://f5-sales-demo.github.io/terraform-provider-xcsh/resources/app_firewall/): Manages Application Firewall in F5 Distributed Cloud.
- [resources/app_setting](https://f5-sales-demo.github.io/terraform-provider-xcsh/resources/app_setting/): Manages App setting configuration in namespace metadata.namespace in F5 Distributed Cloud.
- [resources/app_type](https://f5-sales-demo.github.io/terraform-provider-xcsh/resources/app_type/): Manages App type will create the configuration in namespace metadata.namespace in F5 Distributed Cloud.
- [resources/application_profiles](https://f5-sales-demo.github.io/terraform-provider-xcsh/resources/application_profiles/): Manages Application Profiles in a given namespace. If one already exists it will give an error in F5 Distributed Cloud.
- [resources/authentication](https://f5-sales-demo.github.io/terraform-provider-xcsh/resources/authentication/): Manages an Authentication resource in F5 Distributed Cloud.
- [resources/authorization_server](https://f5-sales-demo.github.io/terraform-provider-xcsh/resources/authorization_server/): Manages authorization_server creates a new object in the storage backend for metadata.namespace in F5 Distributed Cloud.
- [resources/aws_tgw_site](https://f5-sales-demo.github.io/terraform-provider-xcsh/resources/aws_tgw_site/): Manages an AWS TGW Site resource in F5 Distributed Cloud for deploying F5 sites connected via AWS Transit Gateway.
- [resources/bgp](https://f5-sales-demo.github.io/terraform-provider-xcsh/resources/bgp/): Manages a BGP resource in F5 Distributed Cloud for bgp object is the configuration for peering with external bgp servers. it is created by users in system namespace. configuration.
- [resources/bgp_asn_set](https://f5-sales-demo.github.io/terraform-provider-xcsh/resources/bgp_asn_set/): Manages bgp_asn_set creates a new object in the storage backend for metadata.namespace in F5 Distributed Cloud.
- [resources/bgp_routing_policy](https://f5-sales-demo.github.io/terraform-provider-xcsh/resources/bgp_routing_policy/): Manages a BGP Routing Policy resource in F5 Distributed Cloud for bgp routing policy is a list of rules containing match criteria and action to be applied. these rules help control routes which are imported or exported to bgp peers. configuration.
- [resources/bigip_http_proxy](https://f5-sales-demo.github.io/terraform-provider-xcsh/resources/bigip_http_proxy/): Manages BIG-IP HTTP Proxy in a given namespace. If one already exists, it will give an error in F5 Distributed Cloud.

- [resources/protocol_policer](https://f5-sales-demo.github.io/terraform-provider-xcsh/resources/protocol_policer/): Manages protocol_policer object, protocol_policer object contains list of L4 protocol match condition and corresponding traffic rate limits in F5 Distributed Cloud.
- [resources/proxy](https://f5-sales-demo.github.io/terraform-provider-xcsh/resources/proxy/): Manages a Proxy resource in F5 Distributed Cloud for tcp loadbalancer create specification. configuration.
- [resources/public_ip_binding](https://f5-sales-demo.github.io/terraform-provider-xcsh/resources/public_ip_binding/): Manage the regional virtual-site binding of an already allocated public IP. Creation adopts only the binding; deletion restores its captured original binding. This resource never allocates, deallocates or deletes the public IP.

- [resources/srv6_network_slice](https://f5-sales-demo.github.io/terraform-provider-xcsh/resources/srv6_network_slice/): Manages srv6_network_slice creates a new object in the storage backend for metadata.namespace in F5 Distributed Cloud.

- [resources/swagger_object](https://f5-sales-demo.github.io/terraform-provider-xcsh/resources/swagger_object/): Owns one immutable, content-verified Swagger object version. Content changes replace only the owned version. Import uses namespace/name/version; latest and external presigned URLs are prohibited. State contains the complete document.
- [resources/tcp_loadbalancer](https://f5-sales-demo.github.io/terraform-provider-xcsh/resources/tcp_loadbalancer/): Manages a TCP Load Balancer resource in F5 Distributed Cloud for load balancing TCP traffic across origin pools.
- [resources/tenant_configuration](https://f5-sales-demo.github.io/terraform-provider-xcsh/resources/tenant_configuration/): Manages a Tenant Configuration resource in F5 Distributed Cloud for tenant configuration specification. configuration.
- [resources/token](https://f5-sales-demo.github.io/terraform-provider-xcsh/resources/token/): Manages new token. Token object is used to manage site admission. User must generate token before provisioning and pass this token to site during it's registration in F5 Distributed Cloud.
